From the owner
Blackfoot’s Local Restoration Company Is Ready When You Need Us When a pipe bursts at 2 a.m. or smoke is still in the air after a fire, the company that shows up should live where you live. 1st Response Restoration is Blackfoot’s locally owned restoration company, based at 190 Rich Lane, invested in this community, and on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Out-of-town crews can take hours to reach Bingham County. We are already here. Why local matters when the house is wet Water does not wait. Within the first day, drywall can swell, flooring can cup, and mold can start in hidden cavities. A Blackfoot crew that knows the neighborhoods, the weather, and the local insurance adjusters can get drying equipment in place faster than a truck coming from another county. Neighbors have said the same thing in reviews: they called companies outside town that could not help, then found Stephen, the owner and operator, right here in the community. That is the difference between a call center and a neighbor with the trucks. 1st Response Restoration is family owned and operated, with decades of plumbing and construction experience behind the restoration work. The goal is simple: dry it, clean it, and put the home back better than it was before the loss. What we handle in Blackfoot and across Eastern Idaho Our team responds to homes and businesses in Blackfoot and throughout Eastern Idaho, from Rexburg to Malad and over toward Jackson. Water damage restoration. Burst pipes, appliance leaks

Great design is in the details. The execution matters just as much. A beautiful concept is only the beginning. We appreciate the work that interior designers, architects, builders, and developers put into every project. Our role is to help translate design intent into finished work while paying close attention to proportions, materials, functionality, and the details that bring everything together. We believe good collaboration starts with listening, asking the right questions, communicating clearly, and understanding what the project requires before the work begins. We’re always interested in connecting with professionals who take pride in what they create and value quality in the finished result. Before drywall covers the walls and ceiling, the work behind it deserves a careful review. Framing, insulation, wiring, boxes, penetrations, and future fixture locations all need to be coordinated while they are still visible and accessible. This is the best time to catch a missing detail, correct a conflict, or confirm that the room is ready for the next phase. Homeowners may never see most of this work once the project is complete, but it directly affects comfort, function, and how smoothly the finishing stages come together. We pay attention to the parts that remain visible and the parts that will eventually be hidden because both contribute to the quality of the finished project.
